first.code: ClearAll[T,eps,q1,q2,qi,qe,g1,g2,r,k1,k2,b1,b2,bi,chi,kr,ki,rr,ii,A,Eg,Eb,Tm,Tr,ng,m11,m12,m21,m22,s01,s02,s11,s12,p01,p02,e11,e12,e21,e22,t]; w=T^(-3/2)Exp[-eps/T]; M={{g1,-r/q1},{-r/q2,g2}}; Q=DiagonalMatrix[{q1,q2}]; kv={k1,k2}; bv={b1,b2}; forward=qi/qe bi+(Q.bv/qe).Inverse[M].kv; reverse=bi+(Q.kv/qi).Inverse[M].bv; N={{m11,m12},{m21,m22}}; s0={s01,s02}; s1={s11,s12}; p0={p01,p02}; Em={{e11,e12},{e21,e22}}; K=p0-Inverse[N].s0+Inverse[N].Inverse[N].s1; pv=Inverse[N].(s0+t*s1)-Inverse[N].Inverse[N].s1+Em.K; pd=Inverse[N].s1-N.Em.K; Jw=A/3 Exp[(Eg-Eb)/Tm]*(3ng Exp[-Eg/Tr])-A*ng Exp[-Eb/Tr]; <|"MaxwellFirstMomentIntegrand"->FullSimplify[T^2 D[w,T]+3T/2*w-eps*w,Assumptions->T>0],"EffectiveReverseKernelReciprocity"->FullSimplify[reverse-qe/qi forward],"BoundFreeEnergySum"->Expand[-chi*(rr-ii)-kr*rr+ki*ii+(chi+kr)*rr-(chi+ki)*ii],"AffineForcingDynamicIdentity"->FullSimplify[pd-(s0+t*s1-N.pv)],"DiffusionWienDrive"->FullSimplify[Jw-A*ng*Exp[-Eb/Tr]*(Exp[(Eg-Eb)*(1/Tm-1/Tr)]-1),Assumptions->{Tm>0,Tr>0}]|>
